craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn — vitarka as each escape collapses into consequence. Courtesys-art close; purpose-as-metaphor (upacāra thread for v44). Rejected: (a) denying courtesy → killed: concession threads on. Read aloud: WHAT-comes, WELL-formed … BUT-by-COURT-e-sy's-ART.

lines: What comes, well-formed — the wise join part to part;
we call it spirit's purpose — but by courtesy's art.

reads_against.argmap: Purpose-speech — by what right? → Purpose is courtesy-speech — the thread v44 pulls.
c1_essence: Unperceived buddhi grounds no purpose; generic will forces omniscience on each; perception-by-all mixes appearances unless One holds them (vv37-41).
Nature's kit needs no purpose and purpose is courtesy-speech — yet the root-cause would never cease, so no liberation without a perceiving maker (vv42-45).
